notes.title: We are back from Gamescom 2025 and it was a blast! 🎉
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1]Dear Tavernkeepers[/h1][p][/p][p]last week, we were at Gamescom 2025 to present our new game Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker and to talk to the players![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/defe8032cea91ed4534585293c2516e5a82b2144.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It was amazing to see and hear how much people enjoyed the new mechanics and the overall atmosphere of the new settings. Thank you all for taking the time not only to play the shorter Gamescom demo, but also to talk to us afterwards.[/p][p][/p][p]We talked to so many players and even to different press outlets! This is always exciting for us, since it allows us to spread the word and reach a new audience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/c691a75f8df828728372c6b9a72fc3d9ef33adae.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And as always, Gamescom is an incredible place to meet other devs and make fun things happen, like the [b]cozy indie game sticker rally[/b]! We collaborated with 9 different games and if you played all of our demos, you could receive an exclusive sticker sheet![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/fc1e608be17a63d331903a6c521fca12d71a95a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You should definitely check out the other amazing games that made this sticker rally possible!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155180/Pioneers_of_Pagonia/"]1 Envision Entertainment - Pioneers of Pagonia [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2702260/Map_Map__A_Game_About_Maps/"]2 Pipapo Games - MapMap [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133760/Tiny_Bookshop/"]3 Neoludic Games - Tiny Bookshop [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/"]4 Speldosa Interactive - Muri Wildwoods [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824760/Kill_your_Darlings/"]5 Stray Fawn Studios - Kill your darlings [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3890490/Capy_Castaway_Demo/?curator_clanid=45312008"]6 Kitten Cup Studio - Capy Castaway[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201620/Adaptory/"]7 Stormcloak Games - Adaptory [/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589430/Heidis_Legacy_Mountains_Calling/"]8 Humble Reeds - Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337990/Kohlrabi_Starship/"]9 Whimsical Wolff Games - Kohlrabi Starship [/url][/p][p][/p][p]With all the amazing things, there was also a downside. 😱 We had an Andu plushie with us. To show it to others and to give people an idea of how the possible Dindi plushie can look and feel like...[/p][p][/p][p]Well, needless to say, the Andu plushi got stolen by someone...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/816fd73bdfdfa65dd8ffe868140bbd92c0c74c55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While this was a sad moment and Andu never came back to us, we hope they have a loving home with the thief. 🫰 And we managed to get a lot of people [b]interested in the Dindi plushie[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]We are still missing 62 pledges to produce the Dindi plushie[/b], so if you haven't had the chance to secure a Dindi. Now you do![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.makeship.com/petitions/tavern-talk-dindi-plushie" style="button"]Pledge for the Dindi plushie![/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]And last but not least! Cosplayers![/b] We love it so much that people take the time to actually make cosplays of our characters. This is just beautiful and always a highlight. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/0e8f0b4a575188076830d0df1d0ed52512339fb0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With all the ups and downs, this Gamescom was so much fun and it's thanks to all the incredible players like you. Thank you so much for the support and for being there with us. 🥰

Cheers,
Tommy[/p]

notes.title: We need you! - to write a review ✍️💜
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1][b]A Quest to 50 Reviews[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840060/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]We're already at 31!🚀[/b][/h2][p]
My dearest Tavernkeepers and future owners of the Drowsy Dragon, thanks to all of you, [b]we've reached almost 31 reviews on Steam for our demo[/b]. [b]This is incredible[/b] and it's the first time for us to have a dedicated demo page! [/p][p]If you already played the demo but didn't write a review yet, it would help us out so much if you take the time to give us a couple of lines with your thoughts about the game so far. Since it's a bit hard to find sometimes, just click on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840060/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker_Demo/"]the link above[/url], scroll down on the page until you find the other reviews and there you can post yours. 🫰 [/p][p][/p][p]Not only does it help to [b]get more eyes on our game[/b], but just like with our last game, we [b]take your feedback very seriously[/b] and try to implement your suggestions moving forward.   [/p][p][/p][p]As of now, [b]the feedback has been amazing[/b] on our demo for Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker and it shows that we've learned a lot from Tavern Talk and your support. Let's take a moment to celebrate how far we've come. 🎉🥳🎈  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for taking the time to leave a review! 💜  So if you want to support us through those exciting times, always remember that there are three little steps how you can do that:[/p][p][/p][p]                                 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/0eb5302bf8d3e806d317aad1c852f3790f9b9831.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Awesome German Games Worth A Look!
notes.content: [h3]Hey Tavernkeepers,[/h3][p]With the Games Forged in Germany Steam event running right now, we would love to highlight some awesome projects from several German game dev studios! [/p][p][/p][p]We are starting with Toukana Interactive. The devs behind the indie hit [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1455840/Dorfromantik/utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"]Dorfromantik[/url] [/b](which is [b]currently[/b] [b]40% off[/b] 👀) have a very special place in our hearts. Their new game, [b][url="https://star-birds.com/ggt"]Star Birds[/url],[/b] is a [b]relaxing asteroid base-building and resource management game[/b] developed with the team of kurzgesagt - in a nutshell. It combines the [b]iconic kurzgesagt art style[/b] (and birds!) with [b]deep gameplay systems[/b]. [b]They have a demo up[/b] that lets you discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks, and guide your flock of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons! Time to [b]check out the demo and wishlist[/b] this beauty![dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Another remarkable game is [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419080?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][b]The Regreening[/b][/url] by our friends, Positive Impact Games. The freshly founded team of German industry veterans lets you turn a desert into a flourishing green landscape in this cozy simulation game about healing the world. Restore animal habitats, befriend nature spirits, and regrow the wasteland. The [b]art style is simply stunning,[/b] and the game gives you [b]a truly wholesome experience[/b] in these challenging times. [b]Wishlist this gem now![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419080?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Munich-based Jumpy Bit is making a game about making games while navigating the challenges of life. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852750?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][b]The Games You Make[/b][/url] not only features [b]exceptionally stunning art[/b] but also [b]innovative, immersive simulation gameplay[/b] full of consequences to your decisions. Implement features that will probably break your game, hunt down bugs, and chase that mysterious thing called fun. Also, [b]your mom may occasionally text you[/b]. Sounds like something to [b]put on your wishlist[/b]?[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852750?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][b]Cloudscrapers[/b][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"] [/url]by two-person studio Nementic Games is a [b]relaxing, minimalist strategy game[/b] that lets you build the highest tower, continuously adapting to the challenges and opportunities provided. [b]Manage resources and upgrade your building tools[/b] to discover mysterious spheres way beyond the clouds. Even the occasional lightning strike can't hold you back! If [b]cozy building sims[/b] are your jam, you will probably appreciate this one. Time to [b]put it on your wishlist[/b] and [url="https://cloudscrapersgame.com/"][b]sign up for upcoming pre-release playtests[/b][/url].[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If [b]farming on a boat[/b] [b]that's a swimming animal[/b] sounds like something you'd like to explore, you can do so right now! Voodoo Duck has recently dropped a demo for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867470/Collectors_Cove?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][b]Collector's Cove[/b][/url] that lets you set sail on your customized friendly sea familiar ([b]they have hats[/b] for it and [b]you can cuddle it[/b], too!). They frequently run playtests for their game to improve the experience and involve the community. So [url="https://discord.com/invite/vvp2FBUN2m"][b]check out their Discord server[/b][/url] for a shot at participating in the next. Until then, you can [b]enjoy the demo and wishlist[/b] this cozy beauty. Hop on board![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867470/Collectors_Cove?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]That's all for now. Have fun with these awesome Games Forged in Germany, and see you around![/p][p]Your Gentle Trolls[/p]

notes.title: First playable demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there Tavernkeepers![/h1][p][/p][p]After months of careful plotting, writing, editing, drawing, animating, composing, coding and testing, we can now share the [b]first playable demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker[/b] with you! 🍹 [/p][p]And as part of the Games Forged in Germany Showcase, we will share new gameplay content in an exclusive trailer ![/p][p]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840060/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]What to expect of the demo[/b] [/h3][p][b]🌊 Cozy new setting[/b]: seaside tavern[/p][p][b]📖 Whole new story[/b] (of course)[/p][p][b]🕹️ ~30 minutes of gameplay[/b] [/p][p]🧙Introducing[b] 4 new characters[/b][/p][p][b]⚙️ Revised mechanics[/b] for quest-making 🔖 and drink mixing 🍹 [/p][p][/p][p]You playing the demo is a big deal for us, but if you want to help even more, here is how:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How to support?[/b][/h3][p]
🎮 [b]Play the demo[/b]: The more people download and play, the higher it will climb the free games charts  [/p][p]✍️ [b]Review the demo[/b]: This demo will allow for reviews. They can tremendously increase appeal and reach of the game. Every single one helps!  [/p][p]✨ [b]Wishlist and follow the game[/b]: Every wishlist and follow lets other players discover the game.   [/p][p][/p][p]If you are willing to go an extra mile for us you can greatly help us improve the game by [b]filling out the survey about the demo[/b]. [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/pYWcnRxMx1ei6VRD8 " style="button"]Demo Survey[/url]

📋 It will give us deep insight into your initial perception of the game, which is vital for us to make a game that resonates with you, the community. 

If you want to give us even more insights and/or excitement, hop over on Discord and join the conversation. 👾[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/dcRbYHWHMs" style="button"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Being part of the Games Forged in Germany showcase and event is huge for us. There are many talented developers and incredible games from Germany that you should check out! 🥰 So take a look and enjoy this awesome event! [/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany" style="button"]Games Forged in Germany[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Have fun and save sailing,  
Tommy[/p][p][/p]
